title: Gram identity (ι + ι'∘B)*(ι + ι'∘B) = id + B*B
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝᵏ. Let B : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ be a continuous linear map, and put L := ι + ι'∘B : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} (Lean: ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L B). Then L*∘L = id_{ℝⁿ} + B*∘B, where * is the Hilbert-space adjoint (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint), ∘ is composition of continuous linear maps, and ℝᵖ = Euclid p.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (B : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L B).adjoint ∘L (ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L B) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid n) + B.adjoint ∘L B
